columns.Description: Summon a Skeleton Warrior four tiles away.
Deal 3 damage to an enemy within 6 tiles.
Move one tile in any direction.
Move one tile in any direction.
Move to any tile on the board.
Create a Wall of Flames, anything standing ontop will take 4 damage.
Create a Wall of Force, stopping all movement through that area.
Draw a card, then discard a card.
For 2 turns, enemies cannot target you.
For 3 turns, your attacks apply 1 Poison.
Swap places with any character within 3 tiles.

glossary.title: STRENGTH
glossary.body: Adds 3 damage to the next {stacks} attacks.

glossary.title: DOUBLE ATTACK
glossary.body: The next {stacks} attack this character makes deals double damage.

glossary.title: POISON
glossary.body: Deals damage equal to it's stacks ({stacks}) and the end of the turn and then loses a stack.

glossary.title: FROZEN
glossary.body: Cannot act for {stacks} more turns.

glossary.title: SHIELD
glossary.body: Absorbs the next {stacks} damage. Only lasts for this turn.

glossary.title: BLOCK
glossary.body: Reduces the damage this character takes by 3 for the next {stacks} hits.

glossary.title: PARRY
glossary.body: Negates the damage for {stacks} hits and reflects the damage back to the attacker.

glossary.title: ROOTED
glossary.body: This character is unable to use move actions for {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: DOUBLE SHIELD
glossary.body: The next {stacks} Shield this character gains is doubled.

glossary.title: DODGE
glossary.body: Negates the damage for {stacks} hits and moves the character away from the source of damage.

glossary.title: WEAKEN
glossary.body: Subtracts 5 damage from each attack for {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: TAUNT
glossary.body: This character must move toward or attack the source of the Taunt for {stacks} turns.

glossary.title: POISON BLADE
glossary.body: For {stacks} more turns, every attack this character lands also applies {amount} Poison.

glossary.title: STEALTH
glossary.body: Enemies cannot target this character for {stacks} more turns.

glossary.title: VULNERABLE
glossary.body: Adds 3 damage to each of the next {stacks} hits taken.

glossary.title: EMPOWERED
glossary.body: Multiplies {status} granted to all {targets} in range by {amount}.

glossary.title: POTENT
glossary.body: Adds {amount} to the potency of {status} for all {targets} in range.

glossary.title: STANDING WARD
glossary.body: Grants {amount} {status} to all {targets} in range {timing}.

glossary.title: INNATE
glossary.body: Always in hand. Never enters the draw or discard pile.

glossary.title: COOLDOWN
glossary.body: Unusable for {magnitude} turns after it is played.

glossary.title: DORMANT
glossary.body: Unusable for {magnitude} turns after you gain it.
